warning: NO ENTRANCE OR PATH ACCESSIBILITY VALUE IN THIS DATASET HAS BEEN VERIFIED BY A HUMAN AT THE DOOR. Building coordinates are official VT figures (vt.edu building pages and, since 2026-09-19, VT's Enterprise GIS Buildings layer, used to correct 6 of them). Entrance positions are placeholders offset from building centroids and may be 30-50 m out. 29 elevator/chairlift connectors carry confidence='official' from VT Facilities' own asset system (current open/closed status, not a field survey) — stronger than a guess, still not a person who stood at the door. Treat confidence='inferred' as no data everywhere else.

additional_sources.name: VT Enterprise GIS (arcgis-central.gis.vt.edu, public ArcGIS REST catalog)
additional_sources.used_for: 6 building coordinate corrections (buildings.geojson) and 29 official-confidence elevator/chairlift connectors (connectors.geojson)
